subject: Bin lid issue and earlier check
text:
Quick heads up: the recycling pickup bin at the east entrance is not seating properly again. The lid keeps stopping about two inches above the rim, so it looks like it will come open when the truck reaches it. I jiggled the hinge and it seems the latch is catching a bit lower than usual.

I also meant to mention the schedule shifted. The after-school room was moved from Thursday to Tuesday for the next two weeks, so the priority now is clearing the walkway before afternoon drop-off rather than organizing the storage closet. We can still do the bin check, but earlier if possible.

Could you send someone between nine and ten tomorrow morning? If the latch is just bent, please bring the smaller part instead of replacing the whole assembly. Sorry for the short notice, and thanks for being flexible. I'm heading back to the hall soon. Thank you for adjusting when needed.
